definitions.gloss: desperately; frantically; with all one's might
definitions.explanation: Describes putting in maximum effort in a situation that feels urgent or critical. The literal meaning is 'as if one's life depended on it,' but it is commonly used for any intense effort.

examples.japanese: {必死|ひっし}に⟦{走|はし}った→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{必死|ひっし}に⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧こらえて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: He was desperately holding back tears.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{受|う}かる→受かる：19367_ukaru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{必死|ひっし}に⟦{勉強|べんきょう}している→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
examples.english: I'm studying frantically every day to pass the exam.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as an adverb with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ to modify verbs describing intense effort or struggle. Can also be used as a な-adjective ({必死|ひっし}な⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧, a desperate expression). The word originally referred to a situation where death was certain (⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧⟦{死|し}ぬ→死ぬ：00669_shinu⟧), but in modern usage it simply means giving maximum effort.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {必死|ひっし}に⟦{頑張|がんば}る→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧ (to try one's hardest)
- {必死|ひっし}に⟦{逃|に}げる→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧ (to flee desperately)
- ⟦{必死|ひっし}→必死：03705_hisshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧ (desperate feelings)
- {必死|ひっし}な⟦{形相|ぎょうそう}→形相：16174_gyousou⟧ (a desperate look on one's face)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一生懸命|いっしょうけんめい}→一生懸命：01280_isshoukenmei⟧: with all one's effort — similar intensity but lacks the sense of urgency or desperation
- ⟦{懸命|けんめい}→懸命：00216_kenmei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: earnestly — emphasizes diligence more than desperation
